label: UniFi G3 Elevator Starter Kit
description: UniFi G3 Elevator Starter Kit (UA-G3-SK-Elevator) - Elevator Hub: 5x 1G RJ45 (4 reader ports + 1 management/uplink; 1 PoE++ input, 4 PoE+ outputs at 30 W/port, 45 W aggregate). 7 W max without PoE output.

poe.note: Ubiquiti prints one row for the whole PoE side on https://techspecs.ui.com/unifi/door-access/ua-g3-sk-elevator (HTTP 200, 675,251 B, read 2026-11-21): **(1) PoE++ input, 50V DC, 1.2A; (4) PoE+ outputs, 50V DC, 30W per port (Max 45W aggregated)**, with **Max. Power Consumption 7W (Without PoE output)** and **Power Method PoE++**. 45 W is the PSE allocation shared by the 4 reader jacks, not a per-port figure: four 30 W readers total 120 W, so the engine must refuse the last watt. The input row is 50 V x 1.2 A = 60 W, and 45 W of outputs plus 7 W of hub = 52 W fits under it - the vendor rows reconcile here.

notes: Ubiquiti tech specs https://techspecs.ui.com/unifi/door-access/ua-g3-sk-elevator (HTTP 200, 675,251 B, read 2026-11-21): **Networking Interface (4) 10/100/1000 Base-T**, **Management (1) 10/100/1000 Base-T**, **PoE Interface (1) PoE++ input, 50V DC, 1.2A; (4) PoE+ outputs, 50V DC, 30W per port (Max 45W aggregated)**, **Max. Power Consumption 7W (Without PoE output)**, **Power Method PoE++**, **UL 294 Power-limited Class 2 PSU**. **This entry used to model the uplink as the PoE port**: eth0 declared `poeOut` class PoE++ and the four reader jacks declared nothing - the port that is fed *by* the switch was the only advertised source, and with no `poe.budgetW` the loader fell through to the model name, found no wattage and served 0 W (`node scripts/audit-poe-budget.js` listed this file under "Silent (PoE out, no budget)"). The port count closes as 4 networking + 1 management = 5 RJ45 against 1 PoE++ input + 4 PoE+ outputs, so eth0 is the PD input at 50 V x 1.2 A = 60 W and eth1-eth4 are the 30 W PSE outputs behind the 45 W aggregate - the same direction as `devices/ubiquiti/ua-hub.json`. The vendor prints 10/100/1000 Base-T, so every port carries the 10M rung. In the box: (1) Elevator Hub, (1) G3 Reader, (2) 2-wire PoE extenders, (10) Access Cards.
